name: Foundry template
invitation: Copy this pair, then change the preset and the words. This template is not listed in the gallery.
physicalQuestion: What does one fixed shot do against one bank?
nearbySensitivity: The rail is fixed. Yaw 0.5° and yaw -0.5° are rejected before a shot is fired. The only legal tested shot is the recorded opening aim.
validationEvidence: The tested shot is the fixed opening aim. Headless Havok through scripts/range/run.mjs ends on first ground, short of the bank. This pair is the copyable template. It is not listed in the gallery.

limitations.concept: A copyable pair that proves the validator on one fixed shot
limitations.missing: The validator replays recorded shots. It does not search neighbouring aims on its own.
limitations.extension: Leave the replay as it is. A later check can append neighbour setups to testedShots when the launcher is free.
